translation: The Yuliang bone (玉梁骨) is the ear-opening bone. At this place, above is the curved cheek (曲頰) and below is the jaw (頰車); it is the joining clamp of the two bones, and within the ear opening it connects upward to the brain and marrow and also concerns the spirit and intelligence (靈明). If injured by a fall or blow, and there is obstruction to the bone and flesh, with swelling, pain, and bleeding, take Zheng Gu Zi Jin Dan (正骨紫金丹), and wash with Ba Xian Xiao Yao Tang (八仙逍遙湯); after washing, stick on Hunyuan Ointment (混元膏), and avoid cold places when sitting and lying.
